comments.content: Pinned: lean/Thermite/PinExportBoolResult.lean (kernel-checked, BOTH polarity theorems prove). export_item checks only pure_tail_of_block (body SHAPE), never the result SORT. §4 scopes the pure-contract class to bodies denoting in intVal (result r : Int); §4.1 names the bool-result binding (bindBool) as increment-(iv) — so a -> bool item must be ExportRefusal::NotPureContract. Instead it exports tier (a); Denote.lean's intVal bottoms every bool-sorted node to 0, so result binds to 0 for ANY bool body and true/false literals also denote 0: live, 'fn always(a: u32) -> bool req true ens result == true fx pure { false }' (a FALSE contract Verus refutes) is lake-ACCEPTED -> Verdict::Proven, and so is its negation — a REQ-5 Proven+Refuted disagreement seed on a frozen-subset item.
